purpose: Restore away-facing head angle with eyes fully hidden by hair.

arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the selected transparent mermaid sprite to edit. Image 2 is the exact original SLEVEJM2 013 pose and gesture. Image 3 is the established adult mermaid identity, palette and hand-inked cel-shaded style reference only. Rotate her head and shoulders AWAY from the camera into a rear three-quarter left-facing angle. Bring the forward sweep of golden hair fully across the face so BOTH EYES are completely covered by hair. No eye, pupil, sclera, eyelash or eyebrow may be visible through or around the hair. Show mainly the back/side of her head and hair, with only a small lower-face silhouette if needed. Preserve the single visible near arm from shoulder to low elbow to raised forearm, with fingertips lightly touching her chin; keep the far arm fully hidden. Preserve turquoise headband, green swimsuit, torso, hand-to-chin contact, waterline, proportions, colors, bold black ink and restrained cel shading. No extra arm or hand. Preserve clear margins and genuine transparent RGBA. No background, checkerboard, glow, shadow, text or submerged anatomy.
